name: description-list
title: Description List
description: Labels and their values read at a glance, such as a product's specifications: each label semibold beside its muted value.
docs: DescriptionList holds DescriptionTerm and DescriptionDetails pairs, optionally each pair in a div, on a grid of the labels' width and the rest, 12px between rows and 16px between the columns, within 72 characters. A long value wraps inside its column. The static twin is ud-description-list. See DESIGN.md "Listing specifications".
